extracted.intended_audience: authors and writers seeking representation from WME Books / people submitting unsolicited manuscripts to literary agents
extracted.subtask_description: Guidelines for querying WME Books agents and submitting unsolicited manuscripts, including formatting preferences, contact rules, fraud warnings, and which genres/teams to target. Covers procedural and safety requirements specific to WME.

rubrics_metrics.name: Query via agent profile
rubrics_metrics.description: Query the WME agent of your choice via their profile page, accessible via the “Our Team” tab.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: On each profile, you’ll find information about each agent including their preferred query format. Use the query button provided to submit your query.

rubrics_metrics.name: Follow agent's preferred query format
rubrics_metrics.description: Each agent lists their preferred query format (how many sample pages, etc.) on their individual profile.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Review specific query preferences on the agent's profile before sending materials; follow those directions closely (e.g., number of sample pages).

rubrics_metrics.name: Use provided query button to submit
rubrics_metrics.description: Use the query button provided on the agent's profile to submit your query.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submit via the mechanism shown on the profile rather than other ad hoc email addresses or methods.

rubrics_metrics.name: Agreement to Submission Terms & Conditions
rubrics_metrics.description: By sending your materials to our team, you’re agreeing to our Submission Terms & Conditions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Read the Submission Terms & Conditions thoroughly before submitting; submission implies acceptance of those terms.

rubrics_metrics.name: Only query one agent at a time
rubrics_metrics.description: Please be sure to only query one agent at a time as we work collaboratively internally.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you haven’t heard back in six weeks, you may try another agent in the department. Keep agents posted with any developments on your projects.

rubrics_metrics.name: Wait six weeks before querying another agent
rubrics_metrics.description: If you haven’t heard back in six weeks, please feel free to try another agent in the department.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is a recommended waiting period due to internal collaboration and volume of inquiries.

rubrics_metrics.name: Keep agents informed of project developments
rubrics_metrics.description: Keep us posted with any developments on your projects.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If circumstances change (e.g., an offer, publication, revisions), update the agent(s) you have queried.

rubrics_metrics.name: Do not expect a response to every query
rubrics_metrics.description: Due to the volume of inquiries received, we’re unfortunately unable to respond to every query.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Lack of a response does not necessarily imply disinterest; follow the one-agent-at-a-time / six-week guidance for next steps.

rubrics_metrics.name: WME represents books only — no screenplays
rubrics_metrics.description: Please note, we do not consider or represent any screenplays.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The team's focus is 'books, books, books' — do not submit screenplay material to this department.

rubrics_metrics.name: Combating fraud — verify sender email domain
rubrics_metrics.description: WME agents will contact you only from their WME email addresses (@wmeagency.com), not personal domains such as gmail.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Scrutinize emails that purport to be from WME or others in the publishing industry and verify the @wmeagency.com domain before sharing information.

rubrics_metrics.name: Combating fraud — no upfront payments or fees
rubrics_metrics.description: WME agents will never request upfront payments or fees for editorial advice.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Any request for money or fees in advance is a red flag for scams/impersonators.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submit to the appropriate team/genre
rubrics_metrics.description: Select the relevant team and genre for your work (e.g., Fiction: Literary, Thriller/Suspense, Romance, YA, MG; Non-Fiction: Memoir, History, How-To, etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the team/genre listing to target the correct agent and profile; submissions are organized by UK Team / US Team and by many specific genres and categories.
